verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair axis for a productivity and collaboration suite, but the evidence pack documents no retention policies, retention periods, or data deletion controls. The closest items are adjacent features: remotely wiping an account from a mobile device (device security) and listing deleted users (directory administration). Neither is a retention or deletion control over Workspace data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
